customManagers.description: track the upstream project pinned in each 'ARG *_REF=' line, driven by the '# renovate:' annotation above it

packageRules.description: workflow actions are low risk, group them into one pr and automerge patch/minor after a short soak; majors stay manual
an upstream ref bump rebuilds the whole image and can break at runtime on the jetson, so keep one manual-merge pr per project

speaches ships long-lived release candidates and the pin is deliberately ahead of the latest stable (v0.8.3), so unstable versions must stay eligible; renovate never opens downgrade prs (rollbackPrs is off by default), so the older stable cannot win
the dustynv base images use a non-semver l4t tag scheme (fastapi-r36.4.0-cu128-24.04) that renovate cannot order, so bumps stay manual
